summary: Healthcare Interactive Inc. (HCIactive), a provider of AI-powered insurance enrollment and benefits administration software, identified suspicious activity in its network around July 22, 2025. Its investigation confirmed unauthorized access and exfiltration of files between July 8 and 12, 2025, including names, contact details, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, health insurance enrollment and claims information, medical record numbers, diagnoses, lab results, prescriptions, other treatment information and medical images. About 3.1 million people were affected. The company said it was unaware of misuse and offered credit monitoring.
